scheme_name: Medical Assistance and Wage Loss for the Construction Workers
state: Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
other_conditions: Must have been engaged in building or other construction work for at least 90 days in a given year
Must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of the U.T. Administration of Dadra and Nagar Haveli and Daman and Diu
Must have undergone treatment for injuries caused during employment or have a period of disablement
benefits_summary: Provides reimbursement of actual medical expenses incurred due to job‑related injuries and pays half‑monthly wages during the period of disablement.
